text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
All right, dearie! Can I ask you for the
usual
shoulder knocks?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thwap, thwap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give her shoulders the usual massage
and check
the feel of her muscles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're starting to recover their usual
firmness...
but only just. She's still a long
ways from fighting
fit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Pant... Pant... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still profoundly exhausted from the 
Kawasaki Kinen. After putting
everything on the
line to get there,
that's to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the people she hopes to encourage
are surely
back up on their feet. She's
accomplished her
dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then there's Smart Falcon. She was
supposed to
be a guiding light, but her
path has taken her
outside the country.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm running out of ways to motivate Wonder
Acute. Her exhaustion is so deep that no
treatment can pierce
through it. And worst of all, there's no
way to cheer her up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What else can I do?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, dearie. Well, off to the
races.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been thinking about
something.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You make sure you keep your eyes on
me while I
run now, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The words are the same, but they're
missing
Wonder Acute's usual brand of
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that Wonder Acute? I haven't
seen her
in a while. Doesn't she look a
little...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Older? Kinda like a granny? Well, I
guess she's
always given off a granny
vibe now that I think
about it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (I don't know how far I can run.)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(But I have to go as far as my legs can
carry me. I
have to do everything I can.
And then, just
maybe...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(But if my vision starts to blur... What
happens...
if I can't see the goal in front
of me?)
